text:
If you've been out and about this morning, you've seen the pleasant side of today, partly cloudy, 75 and easy, with barely a breath of wind. That calm won't last all day. NWS keeps the afternoon chance of showers and a stray thunderstorm around 30 percent with a high near 81, but the European model is running much wetter today, near 90 percent, so I'd keep the rain jacket handy rather than trust the lower number. Any storms that fire look isolated and quick moving, not a washout.

The lake is calm and swimmable, water's a comfortable 76 and waves stay small, one to two feet, so it's a fine afternoon to be out there, just watch the sky if clouds build and thicken toward late afternoon. Showers become more likely tonight, up to 50 percent, with lows near 60. I'd plan outdoor plans for before 4 or 5 this afternoon and have an indoor backup for the evening.

week.blurb: Storms build in this afternoon and models say count on more rain than the official call, so keep the poncho handy under a high near 81.
Thursday stays mostly dry with a high near 80, but showers and thunderstorms turn likely once the sun goes down.
A stray morning shower's possible before 2pm, then Friday clears out mostly sunny with a cooler high near 76.
Saturday's the pick of the week, sunny and refreshing with a high near 78 and a crisp start.
Sunny start gives way to a few afternoon showers Sunday, high near 78, with better rain odds holding off till after dark.
Monday opens damp with showers clearing by mid-morning, then a mostly dry, partly sunny day near 79.
Tuesday looks like the warmest day of the stretch, mostly sunny and comfortable with a high near 82.
